text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Doses up to 1000 mg/m 2 /day of TARGRETIN have been administered in short-term trials in patients with advanced cancer without acute toxic effects. Single doses of 1500 mg/kg and 720 mg/kg were tolerated without significant toxicity in rats and dogs, respectively. These doses are approximately 30 and 50 times, respectively, the recommended human dose on a mg/m 2 basis.
